paragraphs: GovAI sells an artificial intelligence platform that government agencies deploy across their staff, their leadership, and their citizens. An agency can also embed a GovAI-powered assistant on its own site so visitors get answers there.

The platform ships with Task Templates, pre-made use-case templates organized by department. Those templates cover recognizable municipal work such as grant and funding application drafting. Organizations load their own material through Folios, so assistants and workflows can use a single source of truth. Past simple chat, each custom assistant can be configured with its own instructions, knowledge base, tools, and user access controls.

The company says government staff using the product are claiming back 10 to 20 percent of their work time. On the handling of sensitive material, the site states that every prompt is scanned for more than twenty types of personally identifiable information.
